author: Claude (Opus 5.5), at the architect's request
basis: Purpose read from the 15 archive intent texts (seeds_v2), grouped by what each scheme is trying to achieve, not by its diagram. Drafted before any intent-only embedding existed. Caveat: Claude knows the concept texts and the Pilot 5 idea families, so this grouping is not blind to them.

PF1_separate_community_from_school_day.purpose: Let the hall (and other community parts) open and operate on their own, while the school day stays secure and self-contained.

PF2_one_supervised_public_front.purpose: One legible, supervised arrival point where visitors, families and students meet, with classrooms kept quiet behind it.

PF3_commons_as_social_centre.purpose: Make a shared centre (the commons, or a court around which everything opens) the school's daily social routine and community focus.

PF4_arts_and_hall_as_one_venue.purpose: Join arts and performance with the hall into one community venue, with short sheltered movement between all parts.

PF5_care_and_inclusion_grouped.purpose: Group supervision, nursing and special-education support into a dedicated, well-supported place.

PF6_one_building_short_trips.purpose: Keep most students and staff in one building with short vertical trips, giving messy and service work its own ground-level place.

borderline.E15: Placed in PF3 (reading at the social centre above dining); its 'protected outdoor room' could be a purpose of its own.
borderline.E13: Placed in PF3; it also names 'community entry point', which leans toward PF2.
borderline.E01: Placed in PF5 for grouped support; its first aim (classrooms within one stair of the ground, close to the hall) is a different purpose.
borderline.E02: Placed in PF4; its second aim (a direct indoor link for every mass) is shared with E05 but also with any linked cluster.

note: These purpose families partly mirror the Pilot 5 idea families (PF1 = F4, PF2 = F2), because each seed's intent was written together with its concept. Where they differ (F3 split into PF3/PF4; E09 moving to PF5 with E01) is where intent may add information.
